title: Create a class Github repository
author: Bonnie L Hurwitz
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wv2fe8e
materials: Go to the class Github repository: https://github.com/hurwitzlab/biosys-analytics

steps.title: Fork class repository
steps.instruction: Fork (or copy) the biosys-analytics repository into your own GitHub account, selecting your account as the destination so you obtain a personal copy that you can edit, update, and use for all homework assignments.

substeps.instruction: When prompted, choose your GitHub account as the fork destination.

steps.title: Add instructors as collaborators
steps.instruction: In your newly forked biosys-analytics repository, open Settings, then the Collaborators tab, search for the instructor usernames bhurwitz33 and kyclark, and add each as a collaborator.

substeps.instruction: Click the “Settings” tab on the top bar.
Select the “Collaborators” option in the side bar.
Search for username “bhurwitz33” and add as collaborator.
Search for username “kyclark” and add as collaborator.

steps.title: Verify repository location
steps.instruction: Go to your GitHub account page; you should see a directory named biosys-analytics at https://github.com/<your-username>/biosys-analytics (replace <your-username> with your actual GitHub username).
